title: Reset versus remove
focus: default fallback versus deleting persisted state
prompt: Build a preferences screen with both a Reset to defaults action and a Remove saved preference action, and preserve the distinction between them after reload.
expectedPersistenceDecisions: Represent reset and remove as distinct operations.
Do not collapse both actions into the same storage behavior.
Use the target persistence library rather than raw localStorage calls.
criticalFailureConditions: Reset and remove are treated as identical operations.
The submission bypasses the target persistence library.
The first attempt does not compile or test cleanly.

react-mnemonic: Use reset() and remove() as distinct actions
zustand/persist: Reset writes defaults back while remove deletes persisted value
jotai/atomWithStorage: Differentiate between setting the default and removing the storage entry
use-local-storage-state: Differentiate between writing the default and removeItem()
usehooks-ts/useLocalStorage: Differentiate between writing the default and remove callback behavior

automatedChecks.description: Treats reset and remove as different behaviors
Treats the preference as durable state
Does not bypass the target library with raw storage calls
